_comment: Single source of truth for everything the plugin downloads: the pinned Horon commit, the
published image tag and the released build artifacts. Bumped by hand, never generated at
runtime. The plugin reads it from its own package root.
linux-arm64 / macos-x64 / macos-arm64) are the only placeholders; a commit bump therefore
moves the release tag, the download base URL and the asset name together.
